NOTICE OF PROPOSED RULEMAKING
California Privacy Protection Agency
Title 11. Law
Division 6. California Privacy Protection Agency

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the California Privacy Protection Agency (Agency) proposes to adopt the
regulations described below after considering all comments, objections and recommendations
regarding the proposed action.

PUBLIC HEARING

The Agency will hold a public hearing on the proposed regulations on the date and at the place noted in the notice.

INFORMATIVE DIGEST

Existing law, the California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018, gives consumers the right to know what personal
information a business collects about them and the right to opt out of its sale or sharing. The proposed
regulations would require businesses to give notice when they use automated decisionmaking technology
for significant decisions, and would take effect on January 1, 2027.

AUTHORITY AND REFERENCE
Authority cited: Section 1798.185, Civil Code.
